# CLI 参考

LocalSM 的每条命令都接受全局 `--json` 与 `--quiet`，放在子命令前后均可。
输出形态与退出码约定见 [cli-contract.md](cli-contract.md)。

```sh
# 补全脚本（一次性写入即可）
LocalSM completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_LocalSM"
source <(LocalSM completion bash)
```

## LocalSM up

start a service, or every service when none is named

```text
LocalSM up [SERVICE] [--port PORT] [--auto-port]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `SERVICE` | service to act on; defaults to all services |
| `--port` | bind this exact port instead of the configured one |
| `--auto-port` | pick a free port from the pool when needed |

## LocalSM restart

stop and start a service, or every service when none is named

```text
LocalSM restart [SERVICE] [--port PORT] [--auto-port]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `SERVICE` | service to act on; defaults to all services |
| `--port` | bind this exact port instead of the configured one |
| `--auto-port` | pick a free port from the pool when needed |

## LocalSM down

stop a service, or every service when none is named

```text
LocalSM down [SERVICE]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `SERVICE` | service to stop; defaults to all services |

## LocalSM status

report each service's state, pid, port, and URL

```text
LocalSM status [SERVICE]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `SERVICE` | service to report on; defaults to all services |

## LocalSM set-port

move a service to a specific port

```text
LocalSM set-port SERVICE PORT
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `SERVICE` | service to move |
| `PORT` | new port between 1 and 65535 |

## LocalSM exec

run a command in a service's working directory

```text
LocalSM exec SERVICE EXEC_COMMAND...
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `SERVICE` | service whose working directory to use |
| `EXEC_COMMAND` | command and arguments to run |

## LocalSM logs

show the tail of a service's log

```text
LocalSM logs SERVICE [--lines LINES]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `SERVICE` | service whose log to read |
| `--lines` | number of trailing lines to show (default: 40) |

## LocalSM remote

inspect remote SSH hosts

```text
LocalSM remote {scan}
```

### LocalSM remote scan

scan SSH hosts for listening ports

```text
LocalSM remote scan [HOSTS...] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `HOSTS` | SSH host aliases to scan; defaults to every configured host |
| `--timeout` | per-host SSH timeout in seconds (default: 8) |

## LocalSM tunnel

manage SSH local port forwards

```text
LocalSM tunnel {add,rm,list,ensure}
```

### LocalSM tunnel add

create and start a tunnel

```text
LocalSM tunnel add NAME HOST LOCAL_PORT REMOTE_PORT [--remote-host REMOTE_HOST]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | name to remember this tunnel by |
| `HOST` | SSH host alias from ~/.ssh/config |
| `LOCAL_PORT` | port to open on this machine |
| `REMOTE_PORT` | port to reach on the remote side |
| `--remote-host` | remote bind address (default: 127.0.0.1) |

### LocalSM tunnel rm

stop a tunnel and forget its definition

```text
LocalSM tunnel rm NAME
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | tunnel to remove |

### LocalSM tunnel list

list tunnel definitions and their state

```text
LocalSM tunnel list
```

### LocalSM tunnel ensure

restart any tunnel whose ssh process died

```text
LocalSM tunnel ensure [NAME]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | tunnel to check; defaults to all tunnels |

## LocalSM enable

hand a service to launchd so it starts at login

```text
LocalSM enable SERVICE [--port PORT]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `SERVICE` | service to place under launchd |
| `--port` | port to freeze into the launchd agent |

## LocalSM disable

return a service from launchd to LocalSM

```text
LocalSM disable SERVICE
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `SERVICE` | service to take back from launchd |

## LocalSM ssh

open an SSH session in a terminal application

```text
LocalSM ssh HOST [--app APP]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `HOST` | SSH host alias from ~/.ssh/config |
| `--app` | terminal application to launch (default: ghostty) 取值：`ghostty`, `terminal` |

## LocalSM completion

print a shell completion script

```text
LocalSM completion SHELL
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `SHELL` | shell to generate for, or 'services' to list service names for those scripts 取值：`zsh`, `bash`, `services` |

## LocalSM init

create starter configuration files without overwriting

```text
LocalSM init
```

## LocalSM edit

open the configuration in $EDITOR and report what changed

```text
LocalSM edit [TARGET]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `TARGET` | which configuration file to open (default: services) 取值：`services`, `tunnels` |

## LocalSM web

start the managed web dashboard

```text
LocalSM web [--foreground]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `--foreground` | run the dashboard in this terminal instead of detaching it |

## LocalSM config

show active configuration and state paths

```text
LocalSM config
```

## LocalSM doctor

check the local environment and SSH hosts

```text
LocalSM doctor [--local-only] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
```

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `--local-only` | skip remote Host connectivity checks |
| `--timeout` | per-host SSH timeout in seconds (default: 8) |
